comment.body:
Concentrated ambition combined with mass conformity can produce systems far more dangerous than either alone.

People can:

conform in one context and resist in another,

rationalize harmful systems while believing they’re doing good,

drift gradually rather than consciously choose corruption,

or become complicit through passivity rather than malice.

Likewise, highly ambitious people are not always consciously evil; many genuinely believe:

they are necessary,

history justifies hard measures,

stability outweighs liberty,

or their opponents are dangerous enough to warrant exceptional control.

That ambiguity is part of what makes large systems difficult to resist or even clearly perceive from within. Harmful trajectories often emerge not only from obvious villains, but from:

institutional incentives,

fear,

careerism,

tribal loyalty,

moral certainty,

and diffusion of responsibility.

comment.body:
The #1 assumption being the libel of "homo economicus", aka "rational self-interest": that economic actors pursue their own goals, maximizing personal utility or profit.

That's accurate of the carrion-eaters and bloodsuckers. Can't even dignify them with "predator".

Like all psychotic narcissists do, they generalize their self-characterization onto the rest of us.

How is that "rational"?

And how is self-interest -- in their sense -- rational?

It's rational to recognize the whole and couch our decisions and actions in concern for the whole.

But that's PRECISELY the OPPOSITE of what "rational self-interest" means.

If you prioritize yourself over others, especially to the point that you seek personal benefit at their expense, you are some shade of psychopath.

Maybe you aren't a psychopath in other ways, but you're definitely a fucking psychopath in that way.

Why have we allowed, and why does the vast majority of us still allow voraciously predatory psychotics to take up positions in bullshit-based systems whose sole purpose is to "protect" us until they're ready to butcher us?

As long as you're talking about the systems, you're deliberately ignoring, evading, and desperately denying the psychosis that got us here.

It has a name: codependence.

Fix your psychosis, or die in it. Your choice.

It's all been a PSYOP. All of it.

We're just discovering it as we grope our ways out of it.

Your "history" and memory and awareness and understanding go back all of about 5,000 years: a whole 4 seconds of the day of the Homo genus.

That's the extent of your "knowledge". 4 seconds of the day of man.

You're fucked.

You're not fucked because you know so little.

You're fucked because, knowing so little, you're so fucking resistant to learning the truth.

That you're arrogant pricks who know next to nothing -- so very little that it's easy as farting to PSYOP you -- and yet, you've become so psychotic that you think you're the pinnacle of creation.

It would be funny if it weren't so grotesque.

"Orgy of antisemitism". 

I'm not saying there's no such thing as antisemitism. I'm saying that the entire issue has been so fucked over, compromised, and distorted that merely asking what could constitute valid opposition, criticism, and outrage against the actions of self-identified Jews gets met with such knee-jerk, bigoted antipathy and suspicion that  most honest inquiry effectively gets squashed before it takes its first breath.

People need to learn to recognize thought-terminating clichés. The whole point of the term "antisemitism" is to shut down discussion by presenting the issue in such prejudicial terms that any honest question of the reasons for antipathy towards Jews is damned before you even look at it, presumptively reduced to moral defect, character fault, or psychological problem, before a word is said. 

Honest people don't load language and skew the frame in their favor before listening to a single thing, because when you have the truth you don't need to. You can listen openly, not having judged in abject ignorance what you haven't even heard.

comment.body:
Jesus wasn't non-violent.

That's no different than people living in a cesspool calling the guy that refuses to jump in "non-shitty".

Not only does it say more about them and their frame of reference than it does about the guy with his feet on the ground, but it's really not even about him.

“Non-violence" is something that's meaningful only when and to those for whom violence is central. The truly non-violent don't define or name or label or transact in the terminology of violence.

The issue here isn't our stand on violence -- it's that we don't take a stand at all unless something is psychologically central to us.

For example, you'd never call yourself a "non-rapist", would you?

So why would you call yourself non-violent? Why would you call Jesus non-violent?

Jesus was violent. He just knew when to be violent. And he knew he was talking to people who were psychotically violent and insanely accepting of violence. So, he tried to open their eyes to see three things about violence:





They had no fucking clue when it was and was not appropriate.



Their attraction to violence was insane. Psychotic.



Of all methods, violence is the least effective, one that should be used as a last resort not for moral reasons, but because it's just stupid when more effective options are available.

Violence isn't a moral issue.

Violence is a psychological issue.

This is how I know that those who frame violence as a moral issue, in terms of virtue and vice, without a clue that it's a psychological issue, are hypocrites. They're not interested in what actually works. They're interested in looking good and being judged as good whether they succeed to improve things or not.

The church has moralized violence because the church itself is violent. By becoming the moral authority on violence, it put itself in a position to define the rules around violence, just like governments do with their laws and their completely unjustified, self-bestowed entitlement to create laws.

Both church and state ensconce themselves as authorities in order to create monopolies on violence -- and specifically, especially, to make sure that none of us have any right whatsoever to become violent against them, no matter how violent they are to us, and no matter how violently they violate us.

It cracks me up that so many so-called Christians think that Jesus is going to come back riding a white horse with a sword that comes out of his mouth to literally slash to death millions of people "... slain by the sword that came from the mouth of him who was sitting on the horse, and all the birds were gorged with their flesh," but that somehow *that* Christ is completely different than the one whose "body" is supposed to be on Earth now.

Two different Christs, apparently.

🤣

When I talk about "psychotic", I'm not being metaphorical or rhetorical.
